name: Krown
source:
Chaos rose!? What the hell is going on? But the real question is.... "Can you survive?" And, that's not even the real problem! The real problem is your family. Can you save them? Specially lil sis & big bro who hated each other! Can you reunite them all? Or will you let your older brother Jack take action?

[From Itch.io]
translation:
混沌崛起！？到底是怎么回事？但真正的问题是……“你能活下来吗？”而且，这还不是真正的问题！真正的问题是你的家人。你能救他们吗？特别是互相讨厌的小姐姐和哥哥！你能让他们重聚吗？或者你会让你的哥哥杰克采取行动吗？

[来自Itch.io]
